run_self_reflection.description: Optionally reflect on one archived episode during the initial heartbeat tick.
rules: No payload or closing tag. Optional, at most once on the initial heartbeat request, never on USER turns or follow-ups.
One separate Service request examines the oldest eligible archive for the next observable success or failure. No obligation to run it.
Failure or cancellation leaves progress unchanged. Retry only on a later heartbeat, without a recovery follow-up.
